verdict.rationale: Exa is API-first: search, contents, answer, deep research, and Exa Agent are all documented as API endpoints with official SDKs and an MCP server. Websets, the main visual dashboard product, has a full API counterpart, with results available through the dashboard, API, or webhooks. A Team Management API with downloadable OpenAPI specs also covers admin functions. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that billing (credits, auto-recharge, invoices) and per-key limit management are API-accessible, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
